revise.summary: I revised content/lessons/16-architecture.md and both gates pass: the lint shows no ERROR lines and the course test passes 13 tests. The Site story is rebuilt from repo facts only: PR #7's body and the 1262b31 diff, the judgement calls in the old 07-code-review.md at d21fc2c, route.ts line 3, the redesign spec's "the one seam" line, and the honest "not run here yet" line. I cut the codebase-design run that only the session log backs up, along with its verdict table, the timing and parseCommentInput; the flow Scene also no longer claims to come "from a real run". The Try it step about Manual mode now says Yes to finding the temp folder and to writing and opening the report, and No to any change inside the project, so the exercise works. Claims about the Skills now match the 1.3.1 SKILL.md files: the survey's job ends at a decision rather than "never changes code", it edits GLOSSARY.md inline, it looks at hot spots first and widens if none stand out, the Lessons module has four functions, the folder contradiction is gone, and the copied ask-matt "bench" sentence is now my own words. Five questions were replaced with new ids (turned-down, scenario-unscoped-run, spot-removed-seam, spot-all-speculative, plus why-locality reworded under its old id) to fix two defensible answers, a Checkpoint that duplicated a Final test question, recall-style prompts and wording tells. The prose is 2,854 words by the lint, inside the 1,800–3,000 limit but a little above the 2,800 aim.
